thread:
vivian: Thanks for the all-hands. Follow-up thread: we need a tight, publishable timeline for API / Console / Optimize and clear owners. Keep replies short.
omar: Product summary: API hosted GA (public) target 2026-10-12, internal GA 2026-09-28. Console revamp public GA 2026-11-22. Optimize early-beta 2026-07-14. Owners: omar (API), sasha (Console DX), lee (Optimize infra).
lee: Runtime note: Optimize beta is blocked on batching refactor PR #547 and perf validation. Batching PR targets canary 2026-06-30; perf run 2026-07-06. If perf green, we open beta.
sasha: DevEx deliverables: migration guide, Console admin quickstart, 2 sample apps. Drafts: 1) sample apps stub 2026-06-25, 2) guides 2026-07-18. Need runtime review for samples.
carmen: Leadership: prioritize API streaming + function/tool calls for hosted GA. Console visual polish non-critical; scope GA around admin flows + rollouts + dashboards. Decouple shipping where necessary.
irene: Sales ask: one-page "customer bullets" + FAQ about Dedicated behavior. Need draft by 2026-07-20.
omar: Scope confirmation: API GA = streaming, function calls, rate limits, basic analytics export. Console GA = route/model dashboards, rollout/canary UI, admin RBAC. Optimize beta = batching suggestions + quantization hints (no auto-apply).
lee: For Dedicated tenants, autoscale changes will be piloted in Aug with 3 customers. I'll post pilot details by 2026-07-02.
sasha: Docs freeze window: two weeks before each public GA. I'll coordinate with Solutions Eng for sample app reviews.
allhands-bot: Created task #11021 "AH: publish timeline + owners (API/Console/Optimize)" assigned to omar, lee, sasha. Due 2026-06-24.
vivian: Please mark any blockers in task #11021 by EOD Wednesday. If engineering hits perf regressions, we'll triage immediate fixes or scope cuts.
lee: Will post perf sweep results here on 2026-07-06. If regressions, i'll open a blocker and ping leadership.
sasha: I'll share the sample repo link once the stub is up (aiming today).
irene: Sales will prepare the one-pager draft and post here for review by 2026-07-18.
omar: Agreed 1, we lock the public timeline after engineering confirms the canary/perf runs. Short sync scheduled Friday 9:30am PT to finalize any last scope trade-offs. :calendar:
